description: Detail of one match: statistics or box score, lineups, injuries (soccer: per player type, expected_return and matches_missed; null = not known, never guess), play-by-play, a cricket scorecard (batting, bowling, fall of wickets), rugby scoring events, esports maps and games with player lines, or the singles and doubles of a table tennis team match with set scores.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

part.description: stats, lineups or injuries (soccer); stats (box score) or play_by_play (basketball, baseball, hockey, tennis, american-football); scorecard (cricket); events (rugby, rugby-league: tries, conversions, penalties, cards); maps (esports: per map or game with player lines); games (table-tennis: singles and doubles with set scores)

name: get_match_details
